questions.question_text: By writing each number correct to 1 significant figure, find an estimate for \frac{44.9}{\sqrt{140}} - \frac{2.09^2}{3.7 - 1.85}. You must show your working.
One of these students is chosen at random. Find the probability that this student scored more than 90 marks.
Write down the group that contains the median.
Calculate an estimate for the mean.
Simplify 3x - 4y + x - 5y.
The interior angles of a quadrilateral are 67°, 112°, x° and (x - 7)°. Find the value of x.
Calculate the area of a circle which has a diameter of 6.4 cm.
Share 630 in the ratio 5 : 7.
Factorise 3ax + 4by - 3ay - 4bx.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -4 and 4, where f(x) = \frac{1}{(2x - 1)(x + 1)} - 1.
Write down the x-intercepts.
Write down the equations of the asymptotes parallel to the y-axis.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) for values of x between -4 and 4, where g(x) = 0.5(x + 1).
Solve the inequality f(x) \ge g(x).
A bag contains 5 black balls and 7 white balls. One ball is chosen at random and not replaced. A second ball is then chosen at random. Find the probability that both balls are black.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x using the given table of French and Spanish marks.
Use your equation to estimate the Spanish mark when the French mark is 5.
Is your answer to part (b) likely to be a reliable estimate of the Spanish mark? Give a reason for your answer.
Angle ABC = 90° and angle BAC = 65°. Given AB = 8 cm, calculate BC.
Solve \frac{2x - 5}{3} - \frac{5}{6} = \frac{1 - 4x}{2}.
Factorise 3x(2x - y)^2 + 4(2x - y)^3.
ABC and ADC are triangles. AD = 12.3 cm and CD = 9.8 cm. Angle ABC = 47°, angle ADC = 82° and angle BAD = 12°. Find AC.
Show that angle DAC = 41.6°, correct to 1 decimal place.
Given BC = 16.1 cm, find the area of the shaded quadrilateral ABCD.
At the end of 5 years, the value of Erik's investment at 7.5% compound interest each year is $11 485. Show that x = 8000 correct to the nearest dollar.
Find the number of complete years it takes for the total value of his investment of $8000 to be first greater than $16 000.
The compound interest rate of 7.5% each year is equivalent to a compound interest rate of y% each month. Find the value of y.

A spinner has 24 equal sections. Each section is coloured red or blue. There are x red sections and all other sections are blue. The spinner is spun twice and the probability that the spinner lands on blue exactly once is \frac{4}{9}. Find the possible values of x.
A solid cone has base radius r and vertical height 3r. The total surface area of the cone is 209.22 cm². Find r.
A mathematically similar cone has a total surface area of 1882.98 cm². Find the radius of this cone.
